caption: The drawing features a vertical arrangement of various flowers and leaves. The flowers are primarily shades of pink and red, with some blue and purple flowers interspersed among them. The blooms are clustered closely and overlap in several places, with the pink and red flowers being the largest and most prominent, centrally located. The blue and purple flowers are smaller and appear throughout the composition, often in pairs or small groups. Green leaves of various sizes and shapes surround and intermingle with the flowers, with some leaves showing darker green shading and serrated edges. Thin brown stems and branches connect the flowers and leaves together. The background is a light cream color with subtle sketch guidelines visible, and the floral composition is framed within a faint rectangular border. The drawing is rendered in watercolor, giving a soft, layered appearance to the colors and forms.
title: Wall Paper
